as_told.title: Reagan and Gorbachev musing about uniting if aliens came

plain: Ronald Reagan once quietly asked Mikhail Gorbachev whether the Soviet Union would help if the United States were attacked by someone from outer space, as Gorbachev tells it in an interview with Charlie Rose that is played on the show: "President Reagan subtly said to me, well, what would you do if the United States were attacked by someone from outer space, would you help us." Michels retells it several times, once placing it at the 1985 Geneva summit with Reagan whispering just before talks began, and Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, a former CIA officer, remembers it more loosely as the two leaders musing about joining forces "when the aliens come." For the tellers, it hints that a president had the subject on his mind.
